_comment: After Dark lines: innuendo-level banter between the three adults (docs/SPEC_V2.md section 4). Same shape as data/pets.json; lists are appended to it, only while After Dark is unlocked.

nova: Iggy wears that apron on purpose. I have filed no complaints.
I've stolen Iggy's hoodie. It proves nothing. It smells like soup and Iggy.
My bedside manner is excellent. Iggy has reviewed it. Five stars.
I'd describe our blanket situation as shared custody. Mostly mine.
Duskie winked at me earlier. Or he had sun in his eye. I'm choosing the wink.
Iggy calls me a menace while holding my hand, which undermines the point.
iggy: Nova calls it bedside manner. It's flirting. It works.
I hid the camcorder. Some nights don't need footage.
Nova's in my hoodie again. It looks better on him. Don't tell him.
Duskie said he'd take the couch. The couch has been lonely all week.
"Kiss the Cook" is a suggestion. Nova treats it like a prescription.
Nova gets distracted when I wear my glasses low. I keep wearing them low.
duskie: I knock before I come in now. Those two make eyes at each other constantly.
Golden hour's my best lighting. I've been told. By both of them.
I said I'd sleep on the couch. The couch said "unlikely".
They gave me a key and a drawer. I've been told the drawer is a statement.
Nova blushes under all that navy. You can only tell if you're very close.
Iggy pretends not to flirt. Iggy is very bad at pretending.

nova: Evening. Ignore the hoodie. It isn't mine and I'm not giving it back.
Oh, hi. Excuse the hair. Iggy happened to it.
Welcome back. We're being very normal. Extremely normal.
Hello. If you hear giggling from the kitchen, that's the kettle.
Hi. The blanket fort is occupied. Please knock.
Evening. I'd get up, but there's a fox asleep on me and I'm not moving.
iggy: Hey. Don't mind Nova. He's in a mood. A good one.
Hi. If the camcorder's off, there's a reason. Don't ask.
Oh. Hi. We were just... rearranging the cushions.
Hey. Nova's wearing my apron. He can't cook. He just likes the slogan.
Hi. Late night. Good one so far.
Hey. The couch is taken. By Nova. By me on Nova. It's complicated.
duskie: Hey there. Those two are being cute again. Brace yourself.
Evening. I'm staying over. Again. Nobody's complaining.
Hey. Sorry, I'm in a borrowed hoodie. Borrowed is a strong word.
Hi. If anyone asks, I slept on the couch.
Hey. Golden hour's over. Cozy hour's started.
Oh, hey. They've lost track of time. I've lost track of my socks.

nova: I'm home. Where's my favourite fox? Asking for clinical reasons.
Back. Somebody kiss me, the shift was long. Iggy. I meant Iggy. Or Duskie. Whoever's closest.
Home. I come bearing grilled cheese and cuddle intentions.
I'm back. Did anyone keep my side of the bed warm?
Home. White coat off, cozy mode on.
Back. I missed you two. Don't make it weird. Make it a little weird.
iggy: Back. Who's in my hoodie? ...Fine. Keep it.
Home. Nova, put the kettle on. And then come here.
I'm back. Camcorder's staying in the bag tonight.
Home. I brought dessert. Two kinds. One's for later.
Back. Missed you. Both of you. Don't gloat.
I'm home. Shoes off. Glasses off. Defences off.
duskie: Hey, you two. Am I interrupting? ...I'm staying anyway.
Hey, you two. Brought snacks and a toothbrush. The toothbrush is a formality.
I'm back. Is there room on the couch? Make room on the couch.
Hey, you two. Don't stop on my account.
Evening. The sunset was gorgeous. It wasn't the only gorgeous thing I came home to.
Hey, you two. Scoot. I'm the middle spoon tonight.
